notes_intro: Edit the Markdown notes below. Download your notes and save them as notes.md in this paper's folder, or give the downloaded file to your agent. You can also edit that file directly.
draft_notice: Browser drafts are a convenience. They do not update your notes file, sync between devices, or become visible to an agent automatically.
conflict_notice: A browser draft and the current file snapshot differ. Your draft is preserved below. Compare it with the file snapshot before choosing what to keep. Download either copy before replacing text.
snapshot_heading: File snapshot included in this notebook
snapshot_description: This is the notes file as it was when the notebook was last built.
footer: Original scientific figures remain attributed to their sources. Interpretations and proposed experiments should be labeled beside the relevant evidence.
draft_restored: Browser draft restored. Export to keep an agent-readable copy.
file_loaded: Notes loaded from the file snapshot. Edits will be saved as a browser draft when available.
storage_unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Download your notes to keep changes.
draft_saved: Draft saved in this browser. Download notes.md to save a file for the agent.
download_requested: Download requested. Place notes.md in the paper folder or supply it to your agent.
import_confirm: Replace the current editor text with this file? Download the current draft first if you need both.
imported: Imported into the editor. Download to save further changes as a file.
copy_fallback: Copy the discussion prompt shown below.
previous_heading: Previous editor text preserved during resolution
draft_kept: Kept your draft and acknowledged the current file snapshot. Export to save it as a file.
file_chosen: Loaded the file snapshot. Your previous editor text remains available below for download.
discussion_template: Continue our discussion of {paper_id} ({version}). Use the original figures and preserve my wording. Address these notes, explain unclear figure panels or technical choices, and separate reported evidence from hypotheses. Record responses in discussion.md.
